meta.source: Robert Shiller's US stock market data (S&P 500 composite, from 1871), monthly, as packaged by DataHub (https://datahub.io/core/s-and-p-500)
meta.licence: ODC Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL), as stated by DataHub
meta.note: Returns include dividends, are in the index's own currency and are shown as euros. Monthly prices are averages of daily closes, so crashes are slightly smoothed. Cash is approximated as the long-term interest rate minus 1 percentage point, as a savings account would pay.
